title: Update Contact page CTA button labels

requirements.summary: Change the Contact page CTA primary button label from "Book Now" to "Chat Now" without altering behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Contact page, the CTA button that previously displayed "Book Now" now displays "Chat Now".
No other button labels or headings are changed as part of this update.

file_operations.description: In the CTA button group within the Contact page CTA section, update the primary Button label text from "Book Now" to "Chat Now" only, keeping the existing click handler and styling unchanged.

requirements.summary: Change the Contact page CTA secondary button label from "Send Message Instead" to "Email Us" without altering behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Contact page, the secondary CTA button that previously displayed "Send Message Instead" now displays "Email Us".
The button’s behavior (scrolling to the contact form) remains unchanged unless explicitly updated in a future request.

file_operations.description: In the CTA button group within the Contact page CTA section, update the secondary Button label text from "Send Message Instead" to "Email Us" only, keeping the existing scroll-into-view behavior and styling unchanged.
